spans.s:
अशेव a. [शी-वनिप्-न˚ त˚]
Giving pleasure or happiness.

आसेवा, --वनं
1 Zealous practice,
assiduous performance of any
action.
--2 Frequency, repetition;

अशेष a. [न. ब.] Without
remainder, whole, all, entire,
[]
complete, perfect; अशेषशेमुषीमोषं
माषमश्नामि केवलं Udb.; क्रतोरशेषेण फलेन
युज्यतां

.
--षः Non-remainder.
--षं, अशेषेण, अशेषतः ind. Wholly,
entirely, completely;
तथाविधस्तावदशेषमस्तु सः

अशेषयति Den. P. To finish
completely; स वेद निःशेषमशेषितक्रियः

अशेषस्^1 a. Ved. Without offsprings
or descendents.
[1] Correction submitted by on 20170209. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/336.

असेचन, --नक a. That on which
one cannot look enough, charming,
lovely; नयनयुगासेचनकं मानसवृत्त्यापि
दुष्प्रापम् S. D.

आसेचन a. (नी f.) Charming,
beloved; so आसेचनक.
--नं
1 Pouring
into, wetting, sprinkling.
--2 A
vessel for fluids (Ved.); ˚वत् hollow,
concave.
--नी A small vessel.

असेचन, --नक a. That on which
one cannot look enough, charming,
lovely; नयनयुगासेचनकं मानसवृत्त्यापि
दुष्प्रापम् S. D.

Not befitting
an army.
--2 Not striking.

असेवन a.
1 Not serving,
disregarding.
--2 Not following or
practising, shunning.
--नं Disregard,
disobedience, inattention.

असेवित a. Neglected; disused,
abstained from.
--Comp.
--ईश्वर or
˚द्वार a. not waiting at the doors of
the rich or great.

आसेवित p. p.
1 Performed, done.
--2 Repeated.
--तं Performance.

आसेक्यः A kind of eunuch or
neuter man; पित्रोस्तु
तुल्यवीर्यत्वादासेक्यः पुरुषो भवेत् ।.

आसेद्धृ m. One who arrests
another.

आसेधः Arrest, custody, legal
restraint; it is of four kinds:
--स्यानासेधः कालकृतः प्रवासात् कर्मणस्तथा Nārada;
i. e. confinement to a place,
limitation of time, prohibition against
departure, and restriction from
doing anything.

To carry out,
practise, perform zealously; धंर्म, व्रतं &c.
--2 To indulge in, enjoy;
अग्रवातमासेवमाना

आसेवा, --वनं
1 Zealous practice,
assiduous performance of any
action.
--2 Frequency, repetition;

आसेविन् a. Performing
assiduously, indulging in.
